lang.name: English
bot.welcome:
👋 Welcome to *Claude Confirmator*.
This bot delivers tool-permission requests from your Claude Code session and lets you approve or reject them remotely.
bot.welcome_unpaired: Open Claude Code in your terminal and run `/confirm-link` — it will give you a personal start link.
bot.linked:
✅ Linked to your Claude Code session.
You will receive permission requests here. Send /help for more.
bot.already_linked: You are already linked. Use /unlink first if you want to switch devices.
bot.invalid_token: ❌ This link is invalid or has expired. In your terminal run `/confirm-link` to get a fresh one.
bot.unlinked: 🔓 Unlinked. To link again, run `/confirm-link` in Claude Code.
bot.help:
*Claude Confirmator commands*
/language — change language
/pause — stop receiving requests
/resume — start receiving requests again
/unlink — disconnect from Claude Code
/help — this message
bot.notify.title: 🤖 *Claude wants to run*
bot.notify.comment_prompt: ✏️ Send your comment as the next message.
bot.notify.timeout: ⌛ *No response — Claude fell back to local prompt*
bot.notify.released: ⏸ *Paused — Claude fell back to local prompt*
hook.timeout: No response in Telegram — falling back to local prompt
hook.error.network: Network error talking to Claude Confirmator API — falling back to local prompt
hook.error.api: Claude Confirmator API error — falling back to local prompt
